name: Noodlepunk
source:
The first chapter of the visual novel: "The Heiress".

You're a noodle chef who always has a delicious meal and never leaves a customer unheard or without advice. 

It's up to you to advise whether to score a big deal or not, whether to take revenge or to forgive, whether to push through or to go with the flow.

[translated from [url=https://valersion.itch.io/noodlepunk]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
视觉小说的第一章：“女继承人”。

你是一名面馆厨师，始终为客人备着可口饭菜，也从不让任何人得不到倾听、带不走建议。

该不该拿下大生意，要复仇还是宽恕，要奋力向前还是顺其自然，给出怎样的建议，由你决定。

[译自[url=https://valersion.itch.io/noodlepunk]itch.io[/url]]
